items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: And he was walking around and living in New York, and then we met. And he had heard me and saw me. And he said… and we met like that. “Hey,” he said, “you have the most beautiful humming voice.” Quincy. “Oh, yeah?” [laughs] And [inaudible] we came, you know. And then, he finally had his first movie job. That was with Cary Grant. Walk Don’t Run. [inaudible]. I think I have Walk Don’t Run somewhere. But it was [not?]… And then, he called me to go to Hollywood for that one job. One week. And then, we… you know. One…
Is that Love Story? No. Ali McGraw, yeah, ‘cause… and Ryan O’Neal? No, not that one.
